description: Source file defining ANGLE-specific enums and functions for OpenGL texture types, targets, and related operations, including conversions and operator overloads.

methods.name: TextureTargetToType
methods.description: Converts a TextureTarget enum to a TextureType enum based on the target.

methods.name: IsCubeMapFaceTarget
methods.description: Checks if a TextureTarget is a cube map face target.

methods.name: NonCubeTextureTypeToTarget
methods.description: Converts a TextureType to a corresponding TextureTarget.

methods.name: CubeFaceIndexToTextureTarget
methods.description: Converts a face index (0-5) to a TextureTarget representing a cube face.

methods.name: CubeMapTextureTargetToFaceIndex
methods.description: Converts a cube face TextureTarget to its face index.

methods.name: SamplerTypeToTextureType
methods.description: Maps a GLenum sampler type to a TextureType.

methods.name: IsMultisampled
methods.description: Checks if a TextureType is multisampled.

methods.name: IsArrayTextureType
methods.description: Checks if a TextureType is an array texture.

methods.name: operator<<(PrimitiveMode)
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of PrimitiveMode enum.

methods.name: operator<<(DrawElementsType)
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of DrawElementsType enum.

methods.name: operator<<(VertexAttribType)
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of VertexAttribType enum.

methods.name: ErrorCodeToMessageType
methods.description: Converts an EGL error code to a MessageType.

methods.name: EGLCubeMapTargetToCubeMapTarget
methods.description: Converts an EGL cube map target enum to a gl::TextureTarget.

methods.name: EGLImageTargetToTextureTarget
methods.description: Converts an EGL image target enum to a gl::TextureTarget.

methods.name: EGLTextureTargetToTextureType
methods.description: Converts an EGL texture target enum to a gl::TextureType.
